verdict.rationale: EFTPS documents its own batch channel: tax professionals can pay for multiple clients under a single login using the free Batch Provider Software. That is a first-party bulk capability, but the evidence says almost nothing about what the batches can do, and it applies only to tax professionals. Probes found no API or OpenAPI spec for programmatic bulk actions. Missing for 10: details on batch file formats and supported operations (bulk scheduling, change, or cancel), any API or programmatic bulk interface, access for non-professional users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
